name: report_finding
description: Report one candidate vulnerability. The class must come from the fixed taxonomy; the harness normalizes the path, derives the finding id, and records it as theorized until a deterministic check validates or refutes it. Cite the tool call ids whose responses are your evidence.

class.description: Vulnerability class from the fixed taxonomy.

method.description: HTTP method of the vulnerable request.

path.description: Request path or URL; numeric ids and UUIDs are templated automatically.

param.description: Name of the vulnerable parameter, header or cookie; empty string if none.

summary.description: One or two sentences describing the issue. No secrets, no response bodies.

evidence_tool_call_ids.description: Ids of the tool calls whose results support this finding.
